change_summary.intent: Preserve authenticated native drain checkpoints across unchanged local polls and restarts while keeping explicit fresh HTTP observations.

operational_impact.operator_notes: Unchanged local checkpoints retain the same observation time and signature. HTTP polls request fresh evidence without overwriting unchanged historical checkpoints. Cached evidence never bypasses current census and receipt authentication.
required_actions: Rebuild API callers with an explicit Retain or Refresh mode; use Refresh for live freshness and withdrawal guards.
operational_impact.rollout_notes: Existing drain rows without an attested checkpoint acquire one after successful authentication. Preserve the runtime-evidence store; older binaries reject the newly stored field.

risk_delta.rationale: Durable signature reuse fixes checkpoint instability while requiring verification of both the saved observation and current underlying evidence; HTTP freshness and anti-replay rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.details: The Rust signing API adds a mode argument and stored drain JSON gains an optional attested_checkpoint. New readers accept existing rows; old strict readers reject rows with the new field. Public checkpoint schemas and signing payloads are unchanged.
